focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写出整篇小论文的完整 Abstract（摘要）：在 150–180 词内一气呵成交代背景、核心痛点、方法机制与量化实验结果。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 论文 Abstract 全段，或学术演讲摘要（Talk Abstract）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [背景与任务重要性 Context]：1句话锁定任务目标与核心应用场景（≤20词）。
S2 [现有局限与痛点 Gap/Bottleneck]：While existing [Paradigms] achieve [Merit], they struggle with [Core Bottleneck] because [Underlying Cause].
S3-S4 [本文方法与核心机制 Approach & Mechanism]：In this work, we present [Model], which [Core Idea]. Specifically, [Module 1]..., while [Module 2]...
S5 [量化实证结果 Quantitative Results]：Experiments on [Benchmarks/Hardware] show that [Model] outperforms [Baselines] by [X%] in [Metric] and achieves [Efficiency/Real-world Result].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Context (S1) -> Gap (S2) -> Method & Mechanism (S3-S4) -> Quantitative Proof (S5). 绑定逻辑规则：L001, L008, L010, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Time series imputation is very important in the era of big data. Existing generative models delve into the data distribution but are too slow and fail when missing rates are high. We propose FlowImp, a novel framework that uses conditional flow matching and frequency guidance. Extensive experiments show that FlowImp achieves state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 包含 in the era of big data, delve into, novel, state-of-the-art 等典型低质套话，且没有任何具体机制因果与量化数字。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Recovering missing sensor observations is essential for reliable downstream monitoring in industrial and clinical time series. While diffusion-based imputation models generate plausible trajectories under random missingness, they suffer from high sampling latency and lose global periodic coherence when entire sensor blocks drop out consecutively. We present FlowImp, a conditional flow-matching framework that reconstructs contiguous missing blocks in three ODE solver steps. Specifically, FlowImp anchors straight transport paths on observed spectral priors and enforces cross-channel phase consistency via a lightweight Fourier regularizer. Across six multivariate benchmarks under 50% block missingness, FlowImp reduces imputation MAE by 19.3% compared with CSDI while accelerating inference by 24x.

focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想回应审稿人最常问的：你的模型是不是对超参数很敏感？在缺失值或传感器强噪声下会不会突然崩盘？

paragraph_move_structure: S1 [分析目的 Objective]：We further examine sensitivity to key hyperparameters and resilience against severe sensor corruption in Figure 4.

S2 [超参数平坦区间 Plateau Stability]：Varying [Hyperparameter $\lambda$] across two orders of magnitude ($[0.01, 1.0]$) alters validation MSE by less than [1.8%], demonstrating a wide stable operating plateau.

S3 [极端边缘工况压力测试 Stress Test under Corruption]：Under synthetic sensor dropouts up to [40%] and Gaussian noise ($\sigma=0.3$), baseline accuracy plummets by over [35%], whereas our model degrades by less than [6.5%].
S4 [鲁棒性物理归因 Robustness Mechanism]：This resilience stems from [Specific Mechanism], which filters out corrupted channels before global aggregation.

focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Figure 4 shows hyperparameter sensitivity. When lambda changes from 0.1 to 1.0, the result does not change much. Also, when we add noise, our model is still very stable.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 模糊口语（does not change much, still very stable），缺乏量化波动范围与抗噪机理。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Figure 4 evaluates hyperparameter sensitivity and resilience against severe observation corruption. Varying the phase regularization weight $\lambda$ across $[0.05, 0.50]$ alters validation MSE by less than 1.4%, indicating a wide, tuning-friendly operating plateau around $\lambda=0.15$. Under stress tests where 30% of sensor readings are randomly masked or corrupted by impulse noise ($\text{SNR} = 5\text{ dB}$), point-wise Transformer baselines suffer a 34.2% error surge, whereas DyTS-Net degrades by only 4.8%. This robustness stems from our spectral energy gate, which automatically attenuates high-entropy corrupted channels prior to cross-variate message passing.

focal_blueprints.title_zh: 议论文破题首段：具象趋势锚定 + 争议张力 + 明确中心论点（Zero-Template Hook & Thesis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的第一段（Introduction）：彻底扔掉 'With the rapid development of science and technology, more and more people...' 等烂大街模板，用 3 句话写出考官眼前一亮的母语级破题段。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL Independent Essay 首段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [具象现象锚定 Concrete Trend Anchor]：直接从具体技术变革或制度调整切入（如 Generative AI tools now draft code and summarize literature across university campuses），绝不用 With the development of...。
S2 [核心争议张力 Core Tension / Debate]：While proponents argue that [View A: efficiency/accessibility], critics warn that [View B: skill erosion/inequality].

S3 [带条件的中心论点 Nuanced Thesis Statement]：In my view, rather than banning [X] outright or adopting it uncritically, [Institution/Society] should [Core Stance], because [Primary Reason 1] and [Primary Reason 2].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Concrete Phenomenon (No Cliché) -> Balanced Tension -> Conditional & Specific Thesis Statement. 绑定逻辑规则：L023, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: With the rapid development of science and technology, artificial intelligence is becoming more and more popular in universities. Some people think it is good, while others think it is bad. In my opinion, every coin has two sides and we should use it properly.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 汇集了中国考生三大扣分重灾区：① With the rapid development of...；② more and more popular / good vs. bad；③ Every coin has two sides（零立场的废话中心论点）。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Large language models and automated code assistants have rapidly become routine study aids across university campuses. While proponents contend that these tools accelerate literature synthesis and lower programming barriers, critics warn that unchecked reliance erodes students' capacity for independent problem formulation. In my view, universities should integrate generative tools into advanced coursework only after students master foundational analytical skills, as premature delegation weakens debugging competence and obscures underlying mathematical principles.

focal_logic_rules.category: Domain Discourse (生成模型专属论证)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 生成模型三元权衡论证规范：生成质量、模式覆盖度与采样效率（Generative Trilemma Logic）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Fidelity, Mode Coverage, and Sampling Efficiency Trilemma
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 分析生成模型（Diffusion, Flow Matching, Autoregressive, GAN, VAE）时，段落逻辑应围绕生成三难困境（Trilemma）展开：① 样本保真度（Sample Fidelity / Temporal Realism）、② 分布模式覆盖度/多样性（Mode Coverage / Diversity，防止 Mode Collapse）、③ 推理采样步数与速度（Inference NFE / Sampling Latency）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: While [Model Family A] excels at [Fidelity/Diversity], it incurs [High NFE / Mode Collapse]. -> By reformulating the generation trajectory via [Rectified Flow / Consistency Distillation], our approach preserves [Property 1] while reducing sampling steps from [N] to [k].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 只说 the generated samples look very good and realistic，缺乏分布覆盖度与采样效率维度的严谨坐标。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Diffusion models generate very realistic data, but they are too slow. Our model makes them fast and still good.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: While denoising diffusion models capture multi-modal trajectory distributions without mode collapse, their reliance on tens of iterative solver steps precludes real-time control. By straightening the probability flow ODE via reflow distillation, our generator preserves multi-modal path diversity while compressing inference to a single forward pass.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 精准使用 multi-modal trajectory distributions、without mode collapse、iterative solver steps、straightening the probability flow ODE 等领域高阶表达。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 概念浓缩指代词（This/Such + Summary Noun）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 严禁单独使用裸露的 This / That / It 指代上一整句话！必须在指示代词后紧跟一个精准概括上一句本质的抽象范畴名词（如 This discrepancy / Such degradation / These computational constraints / This trade-off）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Sentence 1: [Full empirical observation or limitation]. -> Sentence 2: This/Such [Summary Noun: bottleneck / discrepancy / vulnerability / shift] + [Active Verb: motivates / necessitates / limits / explains]...
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 句首单写 'This makes the model slow' 或 'Which causes error'，审稿人和雅思考官无法判断 This 究竟指上一句的主语、宾语还是整件事。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Diffusion models require hundreds of iterative denoising steps at inference time. This prevents them from running on onboard robot controllers.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Diffusion policies require hundreds of iterative denoising steps at inference time. This computational latency prevents them from running at closed-loop control frequencies on onboard robot hardware.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 This computational latency 将上一句“数百步去噪迭代”精准定性为“计算延迟”，既消除了指代歧义，又完成了因果定性。

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L026 生成模型三元权衡论证规范：生成质量、模式覆盖度与采样效率（Generative Trilemma Logic））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 包含 in the era of big data, delve into, novel, state-of-the-art 等典型低质套话，且没有任何具体机制因果与量化数字。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。

We present FlowImp, a conditional flow-matching framework that reconstructs contiguous missing blocks in three ODE solver steps. Specifically, FlowImp anchors straight transport paths on observed spectral priors and enforces cross-channel phase consistency via a lightweight Fourier regularizer. Across six multivariate benchmarks under 50% block missingness, FlowImp reduces imputation MAE by 19.3% compared with CSDI while accelerating inference by 24x.

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 具身智能视觉运动策略与仿真到真实迁移
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想阐述具身智能机器人策略（Embodied Policy）如何融合视觉、本体感觉（Proprioception）或触觉，并克服仿真到真实硬件的动力学差距（Sim-to-Real Gap）。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: When the robot hand blocks the camera, the robot cannot see the object clearly. So we add force sensors and joint angles. Also, we predict multiple steps of actions and use an adapter to transfer from simulation to the real robot.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L016 消融实验归因逻辑：移除模块 -> 暴露失效模式 -> 反证模块必要性（Ablation Attribution））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 全是大白话（blocks the camera, cannot see clearly, add force sensors），没有体现异步采样率对齐、SE(3) 动作块与在线隐空间动力学辨识。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Relying solely on third-person RGB-D observations leaves visuomotor policies vulnerable to severe self-occlusion once the gripper approaches the target object. To preserve observability during contact-rich manipulation, our encoder aligns 30 Hz visual spatial tokens with 500 Hz joint proprioception and wrist force-torque histories via cross-modal rotary embeddings. Rather than issuing single-step commands prone to high-frequency jitter, the policy predicts 16-step SE(3) end-effector action chunks smoothed through exponential temporal ensembling. At deployment, a recurrent history adapter estimates latent surface friction and payload mass online, bridging the sim-to-real dynamics gap in zero shot.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Delegating repetitive data compilation to automated systems enables professionals to concentrate on high-level diagnostic judgment. In data-intensive fields such as clinical medicine and structural engineering, practitioners traditionally spend hours cross-checking routine telemetry logs before formulating a hypothesis. When hospital radiology departments deploy automated screening algorithms to flag normal chest scans, physicians can redirect their cognitive bandwidth toward ambiguous pathology cases and patient consultation. Consequently, intelligent triage elevates both diagnostic throughput and clinical care quality.
